findings.title: Stable-fluids step order and kernels
findings.summary: REA located the solver loop `step` (curl -> vorticity confinement -> divergence -> pressure warm start -> Jacobi -> gradient subtract -> semi-Lagrangian advection).
findings.note: Projection reimplemented with a consistent spectral operator: the original pairs a 5-point Jacobi Laplacian with central-difference div/grad, which never reaches zero divergence.

findings.title: Vorticity confinement
findings.summary: eps * (N x omega) with N = grad|omega|/|grad|omega||, texel units in the original; physical units (dx) here.

findings.title: Scalar dissipation rule
findings.summary: s / (1 + d dt) after advection

findings.title: Pressure warm start
findings.summary: previous pressure scaled by config.PRESSURE before Jacobi
findings.note: Not needed: the spectral projection is direct, not iterative.
